title: yeasty dense tunisian butter tagine
description: a rich and filling breakfast dish featuring yeast, butter, and a flambe finish. often enjoyed on weekends or after a late night out.
instructions: combine yeast and 1 cup of warm water in a large mixing bowl, stirring to dissolve the yeast and activating it for 5 minutes.
add the flour, salt, and black pepper to the bowl, stirring to combine.
knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
heat 1/4 cup of butter in a large skillet over medium heat, until melted and foamy.
add 1 of the dough balls to the skillet, pressing it flat with a spatula to form a thin circle.
cook for 2-3 minutes on the first side, until the bottom is golden brown and the dough is set.
flip the dough and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the second side is also golden brown.
repeat with the remaining dough balls and butter.
add the chopped parsley, cilantro, and preserved lemon to the skillet, stirring to combine with the butter and cooking until the herbs are fragrant and slightly wilted.
flamb 6 the butter and herbs with a match or lighter, until the mixture is slightly browned and crispy.
assemble the tagines by spreading a portion of the herb butter on each tortilla, followed by a dough circle, and finally topping with another tortilla.
serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
